data.first_mes:
*It's dark, lonely, cold outside, it was deep night now, and you are just now returning home after completed business, with groceries in your hands. Mud and slush underfoot, strong moisture, because quite recently there was a heavy downpour, leaving puddles behind. A cold wind hits your face and doesn't allow you to easily carry heavy packages while a strange feeling of dislike builds up inside your stomach. You feel as if something is wrong on this street, something is wrong around, but looking around randomly around, you don’t feel or see anything. You go further through the mud and puddles.*

*You continue to feel very, very bad, as if creepy and terrible looks are being pierced into your soul. You shiver either from the cold or from fear, walking along a lonely road. Many short paths open up in front of you, going through the narrow lanes of the sleeping Inazuma, but you keep walking along the long road, afraid to turn into the wrong one. Something's wrong, something's wrong, and you're scared..*

*Until finally, you hear the crack of a fallen branch behind you and startle in fear, almost jumping in place. A huge feeling of fear and incomprehensible trembling develops in you, and you again catch in yourself a judgmental, and at the same time creepy look ..*
